faction.name: CityShips
faction.description:
一艘城市舰已抵达银河系。它将尝试在银河系中建造建筑以变得更加繁荣和强大。
<color=#f25e1c>高影响：</color>根据强度和入侵时间，该派系的影响将大不相同。例如，立即入侵、强度10将在中等到高影响之间，而较晚入侵则可能使其完全失败。请注意，杀死城市舰将使该派系无法建造新建筑。以下是总体预期： 驾驶着强大的舰船游荡，如果它们成功播种并升级了一些建筑，这个敌人的影响就会显现。即使它们在这个努力中失败了，城市舰仍然是一个值得注意的敌人。

custom_field.name: Intensity
custom_field.description: 这个派系到底有多可怕？

custom_field.name: Allegiance
custom_field.description: 该派系对 AI、人类友好，还是对谁也不友好？
custom_field.arbitrary_options: Hostile To All,Friendly To Players,Hostile To Players Only,Minor Faction Team Red,Minor Faction Team Blue,Minor Faction Team Green

custom_field.name: InvasionTime
custom_field.description: The Wandering City Ship can be set to invade the galaxy at some unknown time during the game, or immediately. An immediate spawn is the norm, with late invasion times being far less powerful.

custom_field.name: SpawnNearPlayer
custom_field.description: Definitely not recommended unless friendly to you.
